   ```bash
   gog auth credentials ~/Downloads/client_secret.json
   gog auth add you@gmail.com --services gmail,calendar,drive,contacts,docs,sheets
   ```

3. **Re-establish the keyring** (if needed) and make sure your `.env` still has `GOG_ACCOUNT` and `GOG_KEYRING_PASSWORD`.

⚠️ Note: after `gog auth credentials`, your existing `gog auth add` entry may still reference the deleted client. You may need to `gog auth remove` the old account and re-add it so it binds to the new client ID. The full list of `gog auth` subcommands can be checked with `gog auth --help`.
